name: Zero Trust Audit Team
description:
Eight specialized agents and seven slash commands transform your existing codebase into a fully tracked improvement pipeline.

The code auditor verifies one file at a time with explicit evidence—no fabrication, no vague claims. Findings persist across /clear in .claude/audit-state/.

Commands: /audit:init, /audit:run, /audit:continue, /audit:triage, /audit:fix, /audit:status, /audit:summary.
longDescription:
Ships **8 agents** and **7 commands**.

- **Agents** (8): `audit-orchestrator` (Coordinates the zero-trust audit team), `audit-planner` (Builds the FILE_MANIFEST for a zero-trust audit), `code-auditor` (Zero-trust code verifier), `docs-reconciler` (Resolves code/documentation contradictions surfaced by the auditor), `fix-implementer` (Applies exactly ONE triaged fix-unit per invocation), `re-verifier` (Independent re-audit of a fix), `test-engineer` (Writes regression tests for applied fixes and runs the existing test suite against the change), `triage-analyst` (Turns raw audit findings into an ordered remediation plan)
- **Commands** (7): `continue` (Resume a paused audit from the last STATUS: PARTIAL resume marker), `fix` (Process one fix-unit through implementer -> test-engineer -> re-verifier), `init` (Bootstrap the zero-trust audit), `run` (Run the zero-trust audit across the manifest), `status` (Show current audit progress, open findings by severity, and next recommended action), `summary` (Produce the final audit report), `triage` (Turn raw audit findings into a prioritized remediation plan)

Installs with `claude plugin install zero-trust-audit-team@claude-community` from `bradselph/zero-trust-audit-team`.
